source_cause: The installed relay cleared its redisplay clock whenever Matrix liveActive became false. The Matrix receiver reports liveActive false after the 120000ms live-score lease expires. This restarted the intended 240-second timer at approximately 120 seconds.

source_evidence.corrected_behavior: Relay heartbeats refresh the receiver lease without injecting a new display; the independent redisplay clock is not reset by lease expiry. Package 1.0.1 SHA 88512f4a7e6540161e4f32beaed1373c51c54eeadc9b406bc3dbfb7fd549e135.
source_evidence.basis: Measured live logs plus exact installed source hash and local receiver implementation; no inferential network-only explanation.
